entities.name: C. elegans FAT-6
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt G5EGN2, a reviewed delta(9)-fatty-acid desaturase; sequence identity and coverage are 100%.
A 339-residue multipass membrane protein with four annotated transmembrane helices; associated with endoplasmic-reticulum membrane.
Catalyzes iron-dependent oxidative desaturation of fatty acyl-CoA substrates, preferentially stearoyl-CoA, producing oleoyl-CoA; also accepts palmitoyl-CoA and other substrates.
Functional annotations include iron ion binding, stearoyl-CoA 9-desaturase activity, palmitoyl-CoA 9-desaturase activity, and EC 1.14.19.1/1.14.19.-.
The reaction uses molecular oxygen, protons, and reduced cytochrome b5 electron donors, producing water and oxidized cytochrome b5.

entities.name: Stearoyl-CoA 9-desaturation
observations: Chemical reaction: octadecanoyl-CoA + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 reduced cytochrome b5 equivalents → (9Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA + 2 H2O + 2 oxidized cytochrome b5 equivalents.
Corresponds to Rhea RHEA:19721 and EC 1.14.19.1; the enzyme inserts a cis double bond at C9 of stearoyl-CoA.

entities.name: Palmitoyl-CoA 9-desaturation
observations: Chemical reaction: hexadecanoyl-CoA + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 reduced cytochrome b5 equivalents → (9Z)-hexadecenoyl-CoA + 2 H2O + 2 oxidized cytochrome b5 equivalents.
Corresponds to Rhea RHEA:36931; palmitoyl-CoA is an additional accepted substrate, with palmitoleoyl-CoA as product.

entities.name: FAT-6 sequence properties
observations: Sequence length is 339 aa; calculated molecular mass is 39.06 kDa; theoretical pI is 8.71.
Sequence composition is consistent with a compact, hydrophobic multipass membrane enzyme.
